guide.title: How do we compare prices?
guide.prices: We show monthly subscriptions, included credits or usage time, and verified top-up prices. Annual plans show both the monthly equivalent and the upfront yearly charge.
guide.units: Subscription unit prices are a reference for understanding costs. Credits work differently across tools and do not represent a fixed number of videos or images.
guide.updates: Prices are not collected in real time. After 30 days, a review reminder appears alongside the last verified price. Featured order is editorial, not a quality ranking.

about.title: About
about.description: ToolQuote is an AI tool discovery site operated by eomttt. Start with the video or image you want to create, then compare tool features and pricing.
about.sources: We review official sites and pricing pages and record sources and review dates. Prices reflect the latest review rather than live quotes. Check each service for its current terms and final checkout price.
about.comparison: Recommendations rank matches in tool names, creation scenarios, input materials, outputs, platforms, and features. Matching words and registered synonyms does not interpret every condition or guarantee suitability. Advertising purchases do not affect rankings.
about.revenueEnabled: We may display Google AdSense ads to help cover operating costs. Ads are separate from tool descriptions and do not endorse our recommendations.
about.revenueDisabled: We are not displaying ads at present. If ads are introduced, they will be distinguished from tool information.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How ToolQuote handles search input, connection information, advertising, and external links.
privacy.search: Search input and tool selections are processed in your current browser. The app does not transmit or save them on a server. We do not offer accounts or file uploads. Browser language preferences determine the initial page language.
privacy.connection: Page requests send your IP address, requested URL, and browser information to the server and hosting service. Access logs may be retained according to the hosting service configuration. The site also connects to Google Fonts to load typefaces.
privacy.adsDisabled: We are not loading Google advertising code at present. The app does not use advertising cookies or analytics tools.
privacy.adsEnabled: We may serve ads through Google AdSense. Google and third-party advertising vendors may use cookies, device information, and IP addresses to deliver ads.
privacy.cookies: Google and third-party vendors may serve ads based on previous visits to this or other websites. Advertising cookies allow Google and its partners to show personalized ads. Use the links below to manage personalized advertising and third-party cookie choices.
privacy.googlePolicy: How Google uses information from partner sites
privacy.links: Official links take you to tool providers. Their policies apply to accounts, payments, and personal data on those sites.
